about: Shared fixture for contract airweave-neo/1 section 3 (chunk positions). Positions are exact; labels are illustrative. source_text holds two characters Vespa refuses (U+0003 and U+FDD0); document_text has them replaced by spaces, as Airweave must do before counting positions. Built with target 40 and overlap 16 tokens to stay small; production uses 300 and 45. Fields starting with _ are test aids, not contract fields.

settings.refused_characters: replaced by one space (U+0020) before positions are counted (contract 3.2)

source_text:
# Q3 credit risk report.pdf
Source: google_drive · Path: Finance / Risk / 2026

# Content
Acme Corp's late payments rose 12% in the quarter, driven mainly by small-business loans. 📈 The allowance for credit losses increased to €4.2 million, up from €3.1 million.
Umsatz in Zürich stieg im dritten Quartal um 3 Prozent.
売上高は前年同期比で12%増加しました。
Charge-offs﷐ stayed below 0.5% of the loan book. Page 2 of 2 · Internal use only.

checks: document_text equals source_text with every refused code point replaced by one space; same length (contract 3.2)
no refused code point in document_text or any textual_representation
document_text[chunk_char_start:chunk_char_end] == _test.body  (code points; in TypeScript use the shared codePointSlice helper)
_test.body_tokens <= CHUNK_TARGET_TOKENS  (overlap counted inside the target; header not counted)
chunk_own_start == previous chunk_char_end; for chunk 0 it equals chunk_char_start; chunk_own_start < chunk_char_end (every chunk adds new text)
own ranges [chunk_own_start, chunk_char_end) never overlap and together cover document_text
every taxonomy_spans entry lies inside [chunk_own_start, chunk_char_end)
TypeScript only: String.prototype.slice with these offsets gives the wrong text after the emoji; _test.utf16 shows the JavaScript indexes
